Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1210 PM EST Thu Nov 5 2026

- Briefly drier to start today before scattered showers return late 
today and persist into Friday.

- Temperatures will feel much cooler as highs return to average for 
early November. 

- Drier weather and above normal temperatures favored for the first 
part of next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Cold air advection in the wake of a cold front coupled with the 
broad troughing pattern will maintain copious cloud cover and cig 
heights ranging around 2kft to 3.5kft. The boost in moisture 
advection off of Lake Michigan has focused these lower-end mvfr 
ceiling heights across KFNT to KMBS along with rain showers. 

For the remainder of the afternoon and evening, rain shower chances 
persist across these two aforementioned sites as the boosted mixing 
depths help promote gust potential around 20 to 25 knots. Tonight a 
secondary cold front will push across SE MI, which will result in a 
quick flip from southwest flow to northwest flow along with rain 
shower chances as a line of showers will be possible along this cold 
front. A very brief period for IFR cigs (1-3 hours) will be possible 
with the passage of the cold front, especially with any shower 
activity. The reinforcement of colder air will sustain MVFR cigs 
overnight. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceiling 5000 ft or less through tonight.
